title: London duplex once home to Keira Knightley lists for £11.5M
summary_full: After an extensive two-year renovation, the Hyde Park Gardens duplex in London stands elegantly restored. Spanning 4,071 square feet, the lavish residence boasts three bedrooms and bathrooms, complemented by a private terrace overlooking four acres of communal greens. Available for £11.5 million, it’s perfect for those craving luxury and convenience, with nearby attractions including Connaught Village and accessible transport at Lancaster Gate and Paddington stations.
